description: The same capability, recorded against the frameset web app, replayed against the 3270-style green screen. This is the proof that the surface seam is real rather than asserted: the steps, the semantic targets, the outputs, the outcome detectors and the checkpoint are all inherited unchanged. The only delta is where the session starts and one message that the terminal renders with a hyphen where the web app uses an em dash.

patches.reason: A terminal has no address bar; the entry location is the host and port.
The green screen renders the heading with an ASCII hyphen where the web app uses an em dash.

conditionsReviewedBy: d.jagdale (verified the heading differs only in punctuation)
